Home/Yard/Herbicide.content:
The common herbicides used on Kentucky bluegrass lawns in the US are

2,4D
Dicamba
MCPP
Quinclorac
Mesotrione (Tenacity)

It’s hard for me to find dicamba and quinclorac in Japan.
Some reference solutions are

Home/Yard/Mowing-the-lawn.title: Mowing the lawn
Home/Yard/Mowing-the-lawn.content:
Kentucky bluegrass will grow about 1-2 inches (25-51 mm) per week in its peak season. I plan to cut to a height of 42 mm, and you want to cut one-third or less of the grass in one mowing, so at least once a week is best in the growing season. The best grass height from when I should mow it is 63 mm (2½”). My handbreadth is about 80 mm.
